findings.text: Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
The accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2024 and the next accounts are due 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 26 June 2026 and the next is due 10 July 2027.
The company has 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 555 (appointed 28 April 2026) and PERSON 556 (appointed 16 October 2023), and 1 other officer.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 555 was appointed as a director on 28 April 2026 and PERSON 563 resigned as a director on 26 May 2026.

One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2111, a company, with ownership of shares and voting rights of 75 to 100 percent and the right to appoint and remove directors.
The company has 3 satisfied charges registered, with no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.

Across the 2 current directors checked, 50 other companies were found, of which 6 are dissolved; the directors' other appointments may be incomplete because the same person can hold several officer IDs.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 481 is an active company, incorporated 22 June 2004, with no insolvency record, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and recent changes among its directors.
